body.name: Sallet
body.description: Crafted with a distinctive curved design, providing excellent head coverage without hindering vision or mobility.

body.name: Saltvine
body.description: A pale green marine plant that grows only near the Blue Maelstrom. It is a staple food for the Reeflings, but its high salinity makes it difficult for humans to consume. The Tidewalkers also use it as medicine or in rituals.

body.name: Scroll of Faded Shadows
body.description: A scroll bound with tarnished silver thread. Its outer surface is clean, but within, the text appears deliberately obscured, as if ink had been spilled to hide what once was written. Flakes of old ink litter the parchment, leaving it stained and unclean.

body.name: Scroll of Forgotten Knowledge
body.description: Though countless years have passed, the scroll remains perfectly preserved, its form untouched by time. A strange chill creeps over the one who holds it, as if the past itself were still watching.

body.name: Scroll of Lost Names
body.description: A scroll that once bore the names of many. Most of the ink has faded beyond recognition. Faint traces remain, lines drawn through where the names once were, as if to erase them from the world.

body.name: Scroll of Sealed Curse
body.description: A scroll inscribed with dark crimson script that shimmers with an unnatural glow. Upon closer inspection, it becomes clear the writing is not ink, but dried blood. At times, while gazing upon the faded text, faint whispers can be heard with no clear source.

body.name: Scroll of Vanished Memories
body.description: A scroll worn thin by the passage of time. Its parchment is cracked and brittle in many places, as if the slightest touch might tear it apart.

body.name: Sealed Letter
body.description: An unnamed letter, sealed with wax. Its contents remain hidden within.

body.name: Seashell
body.description: The remains of a dead clam. If you're lucky, you might find a pearl inside its shell.

body.name: Seaweed Necklace
body.description: An ornament worn around the neck by a Tidewalker. Woven from various types of seaweed with intricate care, the necklace carries a faint shamanic aura.

body.name: Shackles
body.description: An old set of shackles. The surface is rough and corroded with age.
